---
title: "Driving Shifts into Reverse"
subtitle: "A connected scatter plot of miles driven vs. gas prices."
format: html
engine: knitr
---

Recreates [Driving Shifts into
Reverse](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/driving-shifts.html) from the
mosaic/vgplot example gallery (adapted from an [Observable Plot
example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-connected-scatterplot),
which in turn adapts Hannah Fairfield's [New York Times
article](http://www.nytimes.com/imagepages/2010/05/02/business/02metrics.html)).

```{r setup}
library(vgplotr)
```

```{r}
spec <-
  vg_create() |>
  vg_meta(
    title = "Driving Shifts into Reverse",
    description = "A connected scatter plot of miles driven vs. gas prices.",
    credit = paste(
      "Adapted from an [Observable Plot example](https://observablehq.com/@observablehq/plot-connected-scatterplot),",
      "which in turn adapts Hannah Fairfield's",
      "[New York Times article](http://www.nytimes.com/imagepages/2010/05/02/business/02metrics.html)."
    )
  ) |>
  vg_data(name = "driving", file = vg_example_url("driving.parquet")) |>
  vg_mark_line(
    data_from = "driving",
    x = ~miles,
    y = ~gas,
    curve = "catmull-rom",
    marker = TRUE
  ) |>
  vg_mark_text(
    data_from = "driving",
    x = ~miles,
    y = ~gas,
    text = ~ sql("year::VARCHAR"),
    dy = -6,
    line_anchor = "bottom",
    filter = ~ sql("year % 5 = 0")
  ) |>
  vg_scale_all(inset = 10) |>
  vg_guide_all(grid = TRUE) |>
  vg_guide_x(label = "Miles driven (per person-year)") |>
  vg_guide_y(label = "Cost of gasoline ($ per gallon)") |>
  vg_plot()

vg_render(spec)
```

<details>
<summary>Comparing to mosaic's own JSON spec</summary>

```{r}
cat(to_json(spec))
```

Matches [mosaic's own JSON
spec](https://idl.uw.edu/mosaic/examples/driving-shifts.html) exactly,
aside from `data.driving.file` (`vg_example_url()` vs. a relative path) and
object key order.
</details>
